Summary.en: Autocompletes a text field with matches from an LDAP directory search.
Summary.de: Vervollständigt ein Textfeld automatisch mit Treffern aus einer LDAP-Verzeichnissuche.
Summary.it: Completa automaticamente un campo di testo con i risultati di una ricerca nella directory LDAP.

Parameter.Property: The LDAP-Property that shall be autocompleted.
Parameter.CSSProposals: The CSS-Style for the proposals-Select-Element appearing when there are multiple matches.
Parameter.URL: The URL of the Formcycle predefined LDAP-Query to use.
Parameter.MsgNotInLDAP: The message to display when the entered value is not found in the LDAP.

Property.default: The LDAP-Property that shall be autocompleted.

CSSProposals.default: The CSS-Style for the proposals-Select-Element appearing when there are multiple matches.

URL.default: The URL of the Formcycle predefined LDAP-Query to use.

MsgNotInLDAP.default: The message to display when the entered value is not found in the LDAP.
